notes.title: The Letter: Classic Edition is now available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I have a new and exciting update today! Our oldest game, The Letter, is getting a new release and slight revamp! The Letter: Classic Edition is an updated version of the original game featuring a new art style with a retro graphics "De-Make". It also has updated UI and better working features including a new pause menu. 

Whether you played the original game on Wii U or missed out entirely, this release will have something new for you!!

Embark on a creepy narrative driven tale about a boy in search of his missing father. It all begins when he receives a mysterious letter.

Do you have what it takes to solve the mystery of The Letter? 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2120410/The_Letter_Classic_Edition/

notes.title: Maze: Pedestal of Trials is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!

It has been a long time in the making, but the spin off sequel to "Maze" is finally available on Steam!

Maze: Pedestal of Trials takes everything you love about Maze, and steps it up a notch!

There is a brand new checkpoint system to help you navigate through difficult mazes and all new interactive puzzles. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1892240/Maze_Pedestal_of_Trials/

If you are a fan of the first game, or a fan of TreeFall experiences, you will love Maze: Pedestal of Trials!

I hope you enjoy this new Maze journey!

-Eli

notes.title: New Puzzle Game From TreeFall Studios
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1736670/Tilting_Tiles/

Hello everyone! 

I hope you are doing well. Thanks for playing and checking out Maze from TreeFall Studios. We just recently launched a brand new puzzle game called Tilting Tiles on Steam. If you enjoyed solving puzzles and finding your way out of the mazes this game had to offer you will most likely love Tilting Tiles. 

The game also features bonus easter egg levels based off of this game as well. They are found towards the end of the game and fit in to the new puzzle style quite nicely. We tend to cross over different game universes in our releases and throw in secrets from our various releases from time to time. 

Tilting Tiles is a minimalist movement based puzzle game. You solve your way across different levels trying to collect every item within a certain move limit. It is an entirely new genre of game-play and we can't wait to see what you think.

Once again thanks for supporting our small studio and checking out this game. If you decide to give Tilting Tiles a play, we hope you enjoy it.

Keep on Mazing on!


-Eli
